habit: be more active
goal: feel more energetic

habit: walk more
goal: stay healthy

Strategy B: Add a 10-minute evening walk to your daily routine

Duration: 21

habit: do yoga
goal: feel calmer and more flexible

Strategy A: Follow a 15-minute beginner yoga video every evening before bed
Strategy B: Do 5 minutes of simple stretching poses whenever you feel stressed

Duration: 28

habit: eat healthier
goal: feel better and have more energy

Strategy A: Replace one unhealthy snack each day with a fruit or vegetable
Strategy B: Cook dinner at home at least four nights a week

Duration: 21

habit: drink more water
goal: stay hydrated and reduce headaches

Strategy A: Drink one full glass of water right when you wake up and one before each meal
Strategy B: Keep a water bottle on your desk and refill it twice a day

habit: eat breakfast every day
goal: stop feeling tired in the morning

Strategy B: Keep easy breakfast foods like fruit and bread always available at home

habit: reduce sugar intake

Strategy B: When you want something sweet, eat a piece of fruit first

Duration: 21

habit: stop eating late at night

Strategy B: If you feel hungry at night, drink a glass of water and wait 10 minutes first

Duration: 21

habit: eat more vegetables
goal: improve my diet

Duration: 21

habit: meal prep on sundays
goal: eat healthier during the week

Strategy A: Cook and portion out three meals every Sunday afternoon
Strategy B: Prepare healthy snacks in small containers so they are easy to grab

habit: reduce junk food
goal: feel healthier

Strategy A: Only buy junk food once a week so it is not always available at home
Strategy B: When you want junk food, eat a full healthy meal first and see if you still want it
Metric: Rate how well you controlled your junk food intake today from 1 to 10
Duration: 21

habit: sleep earlier
goal: wake up feeling rested

Strategy A: Set a bedtime alarm 30 minutes before you want to sleep as a reminder to wind down
Strategy B: Dim the lights in your room an hour before bed to help your body feel sleepy

habit: stop using my phone before bed
goal: sleep better

Strategy A: Put your phone in another room 30 minutes before your bedtime
Strategy B: Replace phone time with reading a physical book for the last 20 minutes before sleep
Metric: Rate how quickly you fell asleep last night from 1 to 10
Duration: 14

habit: wake up earlier
goal: have more time in the morning

Strategy B: Prepare everything you need for the morning the night before so getting up feels easier

habit: have a consistent sleep schedule
goal: stop feeling tired during the day

Strategy A: Go to bed and wake up at the same time every day including weekends
Strategy B: Avoid naps longer than 20 minutes so they do not affect your nighttime sleep

habit: sleep 8 hours a night
goal: have more energy

Strategy B: Avoid caffeine after 2pm so it does not keep you awake at night

Duration: 14

habit: study every day
goal: pass my exams

Strategy A: Study for 30 focused minutes right after school or work before doing anything else
Strategy B: Review your notes for 10 minutes before bed each night

Duration: 30

habit: read more books
goal: learn new things and expand my knowledge

Strategy A: Read for 20 minutes every night before going to sleep
Strategy B: Always carry a book or have one on your phone for waiting times

Duration: 30

habit: learn a new language
goal: be able to have basic conversations

Strategy A: Practice for 15 minutes every morning using a free language app on your phone
Strategy B: Watch one short video or show in the language you are learning each evening

Duration: 30

habit: focus better while studying
goal: retain more information

Strategy A: Study in a quiet place with your phone face down and notifications off
Strategy B: Take a proper 10-minute break after every 40 minutes of studying
Metric: Rate how focused you stayed during your study session from 1 to 10
Duration: 21

habit: practice a skill daily
goal: get better at something I care about

Strategy A: Set aside 20 minutes at the same time every day just for practicing this skill
Strategy B: Track your small improvements in a notebook so you can see your progress
Metric: Rate how well your practice went today from 1 to 10
Duration: 30

habit: take notes during class
goal: remember more of what I learn

Strategy A: Write down the three most important points from every lesson right after it ends
Strategy B: Review and rewrite your notes the same evening while the material is fresh
Metric: Rate how well you remembered the lesson content from 1 to 10
Duration: 21

habit: read non-fiction
goal: gain practical knowledge

Strategy A: Read one chapter of a non-fiction book each morning with your coffee
Strategy B: Write down one thing you learned from your reading each day in a notebook

Duration: 30

habit: be more productive
goal: get more done each day

Strategy A: Write down three tasks you must finish before you go to bed every morning
Strategy B: Start your day with the hardest or most important task before checking messages
Metric: Rate how productive you felt at the end of the day from 1 to 10
Duration: 21

habit: stop procrastinating
goal: finish my tasks on time

Strategy A: When you need to start a task, just do the first two minutes of it to get going
Strategy B: Break big tasks into very small steps and do one small step at a time
Metric: Rate how well you avoided putting things off today from 1 to 10
Duration: 21

habit: wake up and have a morning routine
goal: have a structured and positive start to the day

Strategy A: Do the same three simple things every morning in the same order to build a routine
Strategy B: Prepare everything for your morning routine the night before to make it easy
Metric: Rate how smooth and positive your morning felt from 1 to 10
Duration: 14

habit: reduce time wasted on social media
goal: have more time for things that matter

Strategy A: Set a 30-minute daily limit on social media apps on your phone
Strategy B: Delete social media apps from your phone and only check them on a computer
Metric: Rate how little time you wasted on social media today from 1 to 10
Duration: 21

habit: finish tasks before deadlines
goal: reduce stress

Strategy A: As soon as you get a task, immediately schedule time in your calendar to do it
Strategy B: Set a personal deadline two days before the real deadline as a buffer
Metric: Rate how ahead of your deadlines you felt today from 1 to 10
Duration: 21

habit: plan my day the night before
goal: feel more organized

Strategy A: Spend 10 minutes each night writing tomorrow's tasks in order of importance
Strategy B: Lay out everything you need for the next day before you go to sleep
Metric: Rate how organized and ready you felt at the start of the day from 1 to 10
Duration: 14

habit: focus on one thing at a time
goal: do better quality work

Strategy A: Work on only one task with everything else closed or put away
Strategy B: Put your phone in another room during work sessions so you are not tempted

Duration: 14

habit: meditate daily
goal: reduce stress and feel calmer

Strategy A: Sit quietly for 5 minutes every morning and focus only on your breathing
Strategy B: When you feel stressed, stop and take 10 slow deep breaths before reacting
Metric: Rate how calm you felt throughout the day from 1 to 10
Duration: 21

habit: journal every day
goal: process my thoughts and feelings better

Strategy A: Write three sentences about your day and how you felt before going to sleep
Strategy B: In the morning, write down one thing you are looking forward to that day
Metric: Rate how clear and settled your mind felt today from 1 to 10
Duration: 21

habit: practice gratitude
goal: feel more positive and happy

Strategy A: Write down three specific things you are grateful for every morning
Strategy B: Before sleeping, think of one good thing that happened during the day
Metric: Rate how positive and grateful you felt today from 1 to 10
Duration: 14

habit: manage stress better
goal: feel less overwhelmed

Strategy A: When you feel overwhelmed, write down everything on your mind to get it out of your head
Strategy B: Take a 10-minute walk outside whenever stress builds up during the day

Duration: 21

habit: be more positive
goal: improve my mood and outlook

Strategy A: Start each day by saying or writing one thing you like about yourself
Strategy B: When a negative thought comes, write it down and then write one opposite positive thought
Metric: Rate how positive your overall mood was today from 1 to 10
Duration: 21

habit: spend less time worrying
goal: feel more at peace

Strategy B: When a worry comes up outside worry time, write it down and tell yourself you will deal with it later

Duration: 14

habit: be kinder to myself
goal: improve my self confidence

Strategy A: Every evening write down one thing you did well that day no matter how small
Strategy B: When you make a mistake, say out loud what you would say to a good friend in the same situation

Duration: 21

habit: use my phone less
goal: be more present in real life

Strategy A: Keep your phone in your bag or pocket during meals and conversations
Strategy B: Set your phone to go silent and screen-off at a fixed time each evening

habit: stop watching too much TV

Strategy A: Allow yourself only one episode per day and watch it at a set time
Strategy B: Replace one TV session per day with a walk, book, or hobby

Duration: 21

habit: reduce screen time before bed
goal: sleep better

Strategy B: Charge your devices outside your bedroom so they are out of reach at night

Duration: 14

habit: stop doom scrolling

Strategy B: Replace the first scroll session of the day with a 5-minute walk or stretch

habit: stay in touch with family
goal: strengthen relationships

Strategy B: Schedule a weekly video call with family and treat it like an appointment

habit: be more social

habit: be a better listener

Strategy B: After someone finishes speaking, wait three seconds before you respond

habit: spend more quality time with loved ones

habit: be more assertive

Duration: 21

habit: draw or sketch daily

habit: write every day

goal: express myself in new ways

habit: be more organized
